antisthenes.oneLineZh: 苏格拉底弟子，强调德性自足与艰苦训练，开启犬儒传统先驱脉络。
antisthenes.oneLineEn: Socratic disciple stressing self-sufficient virtue and hard training, a forerunner of the Cynic line.

peirce.oneLineZh: 以探究逻辑、实用主义准则和三元符号学建成美国实用主义的科学形态。
peirce.oneLineEn: Built scientific American pragmatism through inquiry logic, the pragmatic maxim, and triadic semiotics.

zhang-zai.oneLineZh: 以太虚即气、民胞物与和成德工夫开出北宋道学气本论传统。
zhang-zai.oneLineEn: Opened Northern Song qi ontology through Great Void as qi, all people as siblings, and virtue cultivation.

dignaga.oneLineZh: 以《集量论》建立佛教量论，把有效认知限定为现量与比量，并提出遮诠语言理论。
dignaga.oneLineEn: Built Buddhist pramāṇa theory, limiting valid cognition to perception and inference, with apoha semantics.

shinran.oneLineZh: 以他力信心、念佛感恩和凡夫自觉重塑日本净土传统，并开出净土真宗。
shinran.oneLineEn: Remade Japanese Pure Land via other-power faith, grateful nembutsu, and ordinary-person awareness; opened Jōdo Shinshū.

cheng-yi.oneLineZh: 以天理、格物和敬的修养论定下程朱理学核心方向，成为朱熹直接思想源头。
cheng-yi.oneLineEn: Set Cheng-Zhu Learning via Heavenly Principle, investigation of things, and reverence; a direct source for Zhu Xi.

mariategui.oneLineZh: 以秘鲁现实分析、印第安土地问题和创造性社会主义构成拉美马克思主义源头。
mariategui.oneLineEn: A source of Latin American Marxism via Peruvian reality, Indigenous land questions, and creative socialism.

edward-blyden.oneLineZh: 以非洲人格、宗教比较和教育批判形成泛非思想与非洲现代主体性早期语言。
edward-blyden.oneLineEn: Early language for Pan-African thought via African personality, comparative religion, and educational critique.

nkrumah.oneLineZh: 以良知主义、泛非统一和新殖民主义批判构成独立后非洲政治哲学关键节点。
nkrumah.oneLineEn: A key node in post-independence African political philosophy: consciencism, Pan-African unity, neocolonial critique.

macintyre.oneLineZh: 以德性、实践和传统构成现代道德哲学中反自由主义与反情感主义方案。
macintyre.oneLineEn: Anti-liberal, anti-emotivist program in modern moral philosophy built on virtue, practice, and tradition.

lukacs.oneLineZh: 以物化、总体性和阶级意识理论开出西方马克思主义与批判理论前史。
lukacs.oneLineEn: Opened prehistory for Western Marxism and critical theory via reification, totality, and class consciousness.

yang-zhu.oneLineZh: 战国思想人物，因「为我」「贵己」传统而在儒墨之间成为长期对照。
yang-zhu.oneLineEn: Warring States figure whose 'for myself' and 'valuing the self' became a foil between Confucians and Mohists.

ruan-yuan.oneLineZh: 清代经学家、官员与学术组织者，乾嘉考据传统的主要综合者之一。
ruan-yuan.oneLineEn: Qing classicist, official, and academic organizer; a major synthesizer of Qian-Jia evidential learning.

henry-sidgwick.oneLineZh: 古典功利主义的系统化者，《伦理学方法》为密尔之后伦理学给出技术化框架。
henry-sidgwick.oneLineEn: Systematizer of classical utilitarianism; Methods of Ethics gave a technical frame after Mill.

gilbert-ryle.oneLineZh: 《心的概念》以「机器中的幽灵」批判笛卡尔二元论，推动日常语言学派。
gilbert-ryle.oneLineEn: The Concept of Mind attacks Cartesian dualism as the ghost in the machine, advancing ordinary-language philosophy.

wilhelm-windelband.oneLineZh: 西南学派创始人，以规律科学与个别科学之分建立文化科学方法论。
wilhelm-windelband.oneLineEn: Founder of the Southwest school; divides nomothetic and idiographic sciences for cultural-scientific method.

yi-ik.oneLineZh: 朝鲜实学人物，连接退溪朱子学传统与社会经世问题脉络。
yi-ik.oneLineEn: Korean silhak figure linking Toegye Zhu Xi learning to social statecraft problems.

dolpopa.oneLineZh: 觉囊派系统家，以他空见构成藏传中观解释的关键分歧。
dolpopa.oneLineEn: Jonang systematizer whose other-emptiness (zhentong) marks a major Tibetan Madhyamaka divide.

gorampa.oneLineZh: 萨迦派中观系统家，以对宗喀巴解释的批评成为藏传中观内部节点。
gorampa.oneLineEn: Sakya Madhyamaka systematizer whose critique of Tsongkhapa is a major internal Tibetan node.

abraham-ibn-daud.oneLineZh: 《崇高信仰》作者，是迈蒙尼德之前犹太亚里士多德主义的关键节点。
abraham-ibn-daud.oneLineEn: Author of The Exalted Faith; a key pre-Maimonidean node of Jewish Aristotelianism.

gustavo-gutierrez.oneLineZh: 秘鲁神学家，以《解放神学》给出拉美解放神学的问题框架。
gustavo-gutierrez.oneLineEn: Peruvian theologian whose Liberation Theology framed Latin American liberation theology.

gregory-of-nazianzus.oneLineZh: 卡帕多西亚三杰之一，以《神学演讲五篇》定下东正教三一神学表达。
gregory-of-nazianzus.oneLineEn: One of the Cappadocian Fathers; Five Theological Orations fixed Eastern Orthodox Trinitarian expression.

tran-thai-tong.oneLineZh: 陈朝帝王-禅师，以《课虚录》给出越南中世禅学思想表达。
tran-thai-tong.oneLineEn: Trần emperor-Zen master whose Lessons on Emptiness grounded medieval Vietnamese Zen expression.
